about_short_description.short_description: Thya Technology is an online platform delivering AI-based computer vision as a service.

product.name: AI-based Computer Vision Platform
product.description: A no-code online platform that enables the creation of custom detection models for analyzing images without requiring programming skills.

product.name: Custom Detection Models
product.description: Facilitates the development of tailored detection models to identify, count, and monitor objects or characteristics within images.

product.name: Annotation, Training, and Deployment Tools
product.description: Provides tools for annotating images, training detection models, and deploying these models, all within a unified platform.

product.name: APIs and Model Versioning
product.description: Offers APIs for integration and supports versioning of models to facilitate updates and management of deployed models.

product.name: Model Download and Deployment
product.description: Allows users to download and deploy their custom-trained models on various devices or platforms.

identifier.value: Marketplace for Datasets and AI Models

product.name: Marketplace for Datasets and AI Models
product.description: Features a marketplace where users can sell or share their datasets and AI models, receiving royalties for cloned projects.
